Eligibility Criteria :
Branch : CS & IT
CGPA : 7+
Class X & XII : 65% and above
Hiring Workflow :
3 rounds
1. Online assessment ( 7th august )
2 . Technical interview ( offline , at their office ) ( 8th Augus )
3. HR interview ( offline at theri office ) ( 8th augus )
1. First Round (Online Test ) :
2 Section
each section has 35 min and 2 Q
Section 1 : ( 1 easy and 1 medium)
Q1 You are given an integer array A and an integer K ,
Remove the minimum number of elements such that the frequency of
each element is divisible by k.
Return the min number of elements removed.
Q2 Implement a billing system for a Parking lot of Commercial building.
This had a lot of conditions and accordingly was to implemented.
Given the list of cars name and in,out time
1

For each car we have to find the fees for parking based on amount of time stay in
parking .
1 hr : 50rs 2 hr : 100 3 hr : 150 rs
Morethan 3 hr extra charge :Rs 30 per hr .
Section 2 : ( easy medium )
Q1 An integer N is given ,
P is all prime numbers less than N
Q is all fibonacci numbers less than N
Find number of elements is in Q Union P
Sol :
1 to n number prime number ; 1 algorithm have to use ( log(logN)) complexity
Q2 The name was something punished students ,
There are N students numbered from 1 to N who visited a museum.
They entered in the order A1, A2, .., AN and exited in the order B1,
B2,..BN. If the ith student overtook the jth student, then the ith student
will be punished. Any student can be punished at most once
Return the count of punished students.
I solved 3 Q completely .
14 STUDENTS GOT SELECTED IN THIS ROUND
2

2. Second Round (Tech interview ) (OFFLINE ROUND AT DOLAT )(1 hour 40 mins) :
I was interviewed by 2 Senior Employees of DOLAT Capital at their office.The
Interview will be completely on Cpp and OOPs and DSA.
The interview began with Introduction .
Then OOPS Question asked :

Inheritance)
2. Difference in Abstraction and Encapsuslation
3.
Implement Polymorphism with code and example :

polymorphism writing . what are the types of polymorphism
What is difference between polymorphism .
Which func will get called when?
→What happens when base class pointer points to child class
→What happens when child class pointer points to base class
(UPCASTING AND DOWNCASTING)
How run time polymorphism happening at execution level .
Then CPP Question asked :
3 Code written on paper have given and asked to what will be the output . and how

complex increment pre and post both used ) .
